title: Order and Stock Updates
seo: Order and inventory sync between systems
meta: Orders and stock levels kept in sync between your store, warehouse and sheets, with alerts for gaps. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Order and stock updates that stay in sync
overview: When stock is tracked in two places, you eventually oversell. We connect your store, marketplace, warehouse tool or sheet so that a sale in one place reduces stock in the others, new orders reach your fulfilment team, and low-stock levels trigger alerts. We test with sample orders first, keep a log of every change and add a safe way to pause the sync.

faq: Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Amazon, eBay, Etsy, ShipStation, many warehouse tools and Google Sheets. We confirm each one before you order, since not every plan has an open connection.
We add rules to avoid it, such as a buffer or a block at zero, and a mismatch report to show gaps. No sync is perfect, so we recommend a periodic stock count.
No, this service only syncs orders and stock for items that already exist in both places. Listing creation is a separate service and follows each marketplace's rules.
What happens if one system is down?
Updates are queued and retried, and an alert tells you if they keep failing. The pause switch lets you stop the sync while a system is fixed.
